title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 22 日

stories.headline_en: First Snowfall of the Season Hits Shei-Pa National Park
stories.headline_zh: 入冬冷空氣報到 雪霸國家公園降下今年初雪

sentences.en: Cold air brought the first snow of the season to Shei-Pa National Park.
sentences.zh: 冷空氣為雪霸國家公園帶來了今年入冬的第一場瑞雪。

sentences.en: White snow covered high mountain areas above three thousand meters early Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 週五清晨，海拔三千公尺以上的高山地區覆蓋上一層白雪。

sentences.en: Park officials warned hikers that melting snow quickly turns into slippery ice.
sentences.zh: 雪管處提醒山友，融化的積雪很快會結成濕滑的薄冰。

sentences.en: Visitors must carry proper winter gear and check weather reports before climbing.
sentences.zh: 入山民眾務必攜帶適當的雪季裝備，並在攀登前確認氣象預報。

stories.headline_en: Mathematician Claims Claude AI Helped Prove Famous Riemann Hypothesis
stories.headline_zh: 數學家宣稱攜手 Claude AI 證明百年數學難題黎曼猜想

sentences.en: A mathematician at Anthropic claimed he solved a famous math puzzle with AI.
sentences.zh: 一名任職於 Anthropic 的數學家宣稱，他與 AI 共同解開了一道著名數學難題。

sentences.en: He worked with the Claude AI model to study the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 他與 Claude 模型合作，共同研究擁有 167 年歷史的黎曼猜想。

sentences.en: The team shared massive computer files so other experts can check every step.
sentences.zh: 團隊公開了龐大的電腦驗證檔案，讓其他專家能逐一檢視每個步驟。

sentences.en: However, outside scientists say the proof still needs careful human review before acceptance.
sentences.zh: 不過，外界學者表示這份證明仍需經過審慎的人工審查才能正式獲得承認。

stories.headline_en: Singapore Gardens by the Bay Opens Arctic-Themed Christmas Train Show
stories.headline_zh: 新加坡濱海灣花園推出北極風聖誕火車特展

sentences.en: Gardens by the Bay in Singapore opened its popular Christmas Train Show this weekend.
sentences.zh: 新加坡濱海灣花園本週末推出了備受歡迎的聖誕火車展。

sentences.en: Model trains travel through bright flower gardens and tiny scenes from Finland.
sentences.zh: 模型火車穿梭在繽紛的花園與來自芬蘭的迷你造景之間。

sentences.en: Families can explore Santa's cozy wooden home and see cheerful holiday trees.
sentences.zh: 親子旅客可以探索聖誕老人溫馨的木屋，並欣賞充滿節慶氣氛的聖誕樹。

sentences.en: The festive indoor display will welcome travelers from around the world until January.
sentences.zh: 這場充滿節日氣息的室內展覽將開放至明年一月，迎接來自世界各地的旅客。
